entradas.text: "I'm sure he also pressured the Justices of the Court against your proposal right after that win. I hate to be on his side but I don't agree with your proposal either."
"You call this proposal *democratic*, but we know it's a power grab, Mr. President. I'm only doing this out of respect."
"I've organized this meeting because I am still a part of the cabinet. Consider this a favour from my side."
"Lucian and Petr believe that he can be persuaded too. Whatever you do, I am not with you."
"What about Heron?"
entradas.menu: "What about Heron?"

entradas.text: "We won the vote. I can still persuade Orso."
entradas.menu: "We won the vote. I can still persuade Orso."

entradas.text: "Mrs. Morgna. Don't do this. I need your vote."
entradas.menu: "Mrs. Morgna. Don't do this. I need your vote."

entradas.text: "I thought we've been through this."
"Well, I'm not helping with that."
"He's not willing to talk. I doubt you can do anything about that."
"There's nothing else."
entradas.menu: "There's nothing else."

entradas.text: "Oh, now you want to cooperate with the Old Guards, after all?"
"Thank you for your efforts with the Anti-corruption police."
entradas.menu: "Thank you for your efforts with the Anti-corruption police."

entradas.text: "Fine."
"He's doing his best to organize the Court against your proposal."
"I guess we have... maybe 5 minutes?"
"Thank you for signing the order, Mr. President. But do not think that the force is a political tool."
"She's certainly open to dialogue but also sceptical. She seemed to be scared of a potential purge against the Court."
"Interesting. Maybe I should play into that."
entradas.menu: "Interesting. Maybe I should play into that."

entradas.text: "We can find common ground against the Old Guard."
entradas.menu: "We can find common ground against the Old Guard."

entradas.text: "Their weakest link is Heron, but the rest are unbreakable."
"So, you think she's scared of us?"
entradas.menu: "So, you think she's scared of us?"

entradas.text: "When will Isabel be here?"
entradas.menu: "When will Isabel be here?"

entradas.text: "She's not entirely scared about the situation, but then again, none of the court even believed that you would succeed in the Assembly."
She looked at her watch.
"Maybe she's feeling the pressure now. But in any case, you'll discover that soon enough."
"Having common enemies doesn't always result in an alliance. As you know..."
"Do whatever you want, Mr. President. Isabel might be feeling the pressure after the vote, but she's not a weak woman."
"We need to talk to Heron, then."
entradas.menu: "We need to talk to Heron, then."

entradas.text: "But there's huge pressure on them. The Anti-corruption force has found incriminating evidence against some of the Justices."
"You still need six votes from somewhere. Isabel can potentially bring two to three votes, that's why she's your ticket. But I doubt it will work out."
"What is the atmosphere in the Court?"
entradas.menu: "What is the atmosphere in the Court?"

entradas.text: "The Old Guards are fanatically opposing your proposal too."
"You are right, but where's the breaking point?"
"What about Justice Edmonds? Does she share your views?"
entradas.menu: "What about Justice Edmonds? Does she share your views?"

entradas.text: "She's not openly protesting against the Old Guards but she has told me about her concerns about them."
"Your openness to talk to Heron is already showing me your true intentions..."
"Somewhat, yes. We are not ideologically entirely aligned but she's still someone who has a sense of justice."
"She must also be under pressure after the anti-corruption police's raids against her fellow colleagues."
"We have to keep up the pressure."
entradas.menu: "We have to keep up the pressure."

entradas.text: "Nobody is unbreakable."
entradas.menu: "Nobody is unbreakable."

entradas.text: "Although they have immunity, they are scared that these would go public. You might have already gained a few more votes in the Court but I'm not sure more Old Guards would jump on the same wagon."
"It is the Old Guard that are disrespecting their positions. You cannot bring down the Court. With all due respect, it is the *President* who needs to *finally learn to back down*."
"What has Orso been doing?"
entradas.menu: "What has Orso been doing?"

entradas.text: "Good. The whole Court must finally learn to back down."
entradas.menu: "Good. The whole Court must finally learn to back down."

entradas.text: "I won't let their efforts be exploited."
"I only know about the two Justices I've mentioned earlier who are with me. So we have three votes there. Against you."
"Is this a battle against the Court, Mr. President?"
"These old men have a pride as vast as Merkopa, they're not easy to break. And... This is not a game, Mr. President."
"Anyway..."
"They can keep relying on their immunity. Soon, we will be able to impeach them."
entradas.menu: "They can keep relying on their immunity. Soon, we will be able to impeach them."

entradas.text: "The investigations are still going, Mr. President. The pressure will build up."
"With the ongoing investigations of the anti-corruption force, I'm sure we will have a strong position against most of the Old Guards regarding their impeachment."
"Most Justices don't really talk when I'm around. They don't trust me as I'm an outside member of the Court."
"But I still think it was not the right decision to add that to the proposal. This might pressure the future Courts to always be in line with the fear of being displaced."
"Thank you Mrs. Morgna. This means a lot."
entradas.menu: "Thank you Mrs. Morgna. This means a lot."

entradas.text: "Are you saying that you will vote against the proposal?"
entradas.menu: "Are you saying that you will vote against the proposal?"

entradas.text: "I'm disappointed, Mrs. Morgna. I thought I'd be able to change your mind."
entradas.menu: "I'm disappointed, Mrs. Morgna. I thought I'd be able to change your mind."

entradas.text: "I believe my position was clear from the beginning."
"It should, Mr. President. I'm aiding you against what I believe in."
"Of course, that won't stop me from doing what I can to make it fail."
"But anyway... Let me know if there's something else... I'd be taking my leave as soon as Mrs. Edmonds gets here."
"It is a battle that I will win. Yes."
entradas.menu: "It is a battle that I will win. Yes."

entradas.text: "Watch your words, Mrs. Morgna."
entradas.menu: "Watch your words, Mrs. Morgna."

entradas.text: "I'm sorry to hear that you feel this way."
entradas.menu: "I'm sorry to hear that you feel this way."

entradas.text: "Having common enemies doesn't always result in an alliance. But I doubt that they are really your *enemies.*
"The Old Guards were fanatically opposing any constitutional changes. But I think they are not that discontent anymore... Since you are protecting the status quo..."
"We won the vote. That might have changed their minds."
entradas.menu: "We won the vote. That might have changed their minds."

entradas.text: "Maybe..."
"So the problem is not the Old Guards but you..."
entradas.menu: "So the problem is not the Old Guards but you..."

entradas.text: "I thought we've been through this. I organized a meeting for you, didn't I? Don't even try to attack me with that..."
